TranslationContext: This file contains strings from Unit Deeds and acheivements.

Translations.Comment: Achievement title - tree monsters are woodland creatures
Achievement title - war machines are mechanical units

Translations.Key: Fled off the battlefield with zero casualties.
Translations.Translation: Бежал с поля боя без потерь.

Translations.Comment: Trait name - unfortunate with dice rolls
Achievement title - unit that doesn't contribute

Translations.Key: Killed no enemies, lost no models, took no objectives.
Translations.Translation: Не убил врагов, не потерял бойцов, не захватил объектов.

Translations.Comment: Higher tier lucky achievement - blessed by fortune
Higher tier unlucky achievement - cursed with bad luck
